Definition: The ground of a 3D world: hills, valleys and flat land, stored as heights.
A grid of numbers, one height for each point on the ground. Quorum stores each region's heightmap as an image.
One point on a heightmap, with its own height.
One square piece of a terrain. Large terrains are made of many regions, so only some need to be loaded at once.
The distance, in world units, between two neighboring samples. In code it is called the vertex spacing.
The point 0, 0, 0 in a scene. A terrain always stays there.
